name: Yatomi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yatomi city emblem in navy: a stylised device of a ring with a pointed top and a vertical arrow.
history: Municipal flag of Yatomi, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 1966.

features.role: Yatomi city emblem — a stylised device of a ring with a pointed top and a vertical arrow
